Real-estate infrastructure

Trust is infrastructure.

AVAN is real-estate trust and transaction infrastructure. It brings property, identity, documentation and transaction controls into one accountable process.

AVANIn development
Visit AVANdist-peach-ten-62.vercel.app
Approach

A transaction is only as strong as the systems around it.

Property transactions depend on more than discovery. They require reliable title information, verified participants, professional review, clear documentation and a record of what happened. AVAN is being built around these foundations, for individuals, developers, diaspora buyers and institutions.

Property and title verification

Property records, title and supporting documents are examined within a structured verification workflow.

Identity and compliance

Buyer and seller identity verification, KYC and AML controls support accountable participation.

Bank-held escrow

Banks hold transaction funds. AVAN provides the technology and controls surrounding the process.

Milestone releases

Release conditions connect payment decisions to agreed milestones and supporting evidence.

Professionals and inspections

Inspections and professional involvement form part of the transaction workflow.

Investment infrastructure

Documentation, auditability and transaction records support connections to mortgages, development and institutional investment.

AVAN is non-custodial. Transaction funds are held by banks, not by AVAN. These areas describe the infrastructure being built; they are not a claim that every capability is currently available.
